caption:
Light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale

The Prophet ﷺ named two short phrases glorifying Allah that are light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale, and beloved to the Most Merciful. They take only seconds to say.

Jami at-Tirmidhi 3467 · Grade: Sahih

Say both before you put your phone down tonight

#dhikr #subhanallah #easydeeds #hadithreels
alt_text: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “There are two statements that are light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale, and beloved to Ar-Raḥmān: “Glory is to Allah and the praise; Glory is to Allah, the Magnificent. (Subḥān Allāhi wa biḥamdih, Subḥān Allāhil-Aẓīm)” (Jami at-Tirmidhi 3467)
